name: agentic-undo-redo
description: Smart undo and redo for AI coding agents (Claude Code and Codex CLI today; Cursor/Aider/OpenHands on the roadmap), backed by jj's op log.

scripts.test: npm run test:static && npm run test:integration && npm run test:artifact
scripts.test:static: bash -n install.sh uninstall.sh install.curl.sh plugins/claude-code-undo-redo/hooks/jj-autosnapshot.sh plugins/claude-code-undo-redo/hooks/jj-mark-turn.sh plugins/claude-code-undo-redo/statusline.sh plugins/codex-undo-redo/hooks/jj-autosnapshot.sh plugins/codex-undo-redo/hooks/jj-mark-turn.sh tests/integration.sh tests/artifact-smoke.sh tests/testbed-smoke.sh && jq -e . .claude-plugin/marketplace.json >/dev/null && jq -e 'has("hooks") | not' plugins/claude-code-undo-redo/.claude-plugin/plugin.json >/dev/null && jq -e . plugins/codex-undo-redo/.codex-plugin/plugin.json >/dev/null && jq -e '.hooks.UserPromptSubmit[] | .hooks | type == "array" and length > 0' plugins/claude-code-undo-redo/hooks/hooks.json >/dev/null && jq -e '.hooks.UserPromptSubmit[] | .hooks | type == "array" and length > 0' plugins/codex-undo-redo/hooks/hooks.json >/dev/null

author: Alex Ververis
